newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Suriname president ends visit to Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: Suriname president ends visit to Venezuela.

text.p: Suriname's President Jules Wijdenbosch on Friday ended a three-day official visit to Venezuela during which the two countries agreed on closer cooperation.
Wijdenbosch left in a private plane from the Santiago Marino international airport, officials said.
He signed a joint statement with Venezuela's President Rafael Caldera on Thursday in which they pledged to work together on energy, housing, the fight against drug trafficking and other issues.
